hook: orphan 身體團來體檢：corporeal／marrow／morbid／malinger——醫生畫漫畫圖解，病人還在裝病。
script: corporeal 肉體的。marrow 精華／骨髓。morbid 病態。malinger 裝病。bedraggled 邋遢。carrion 腐肉。口令：體檢寫「誠實」，裝病寫「攝影機開着」。

members.senseAnchor: having material or physical form or substance;  - Benjamin Jowett; affecting or characteristic of the body as opposed to the mind or spirit
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 肉體標: corporeal walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「肉體標」出場：corporeal 一上場梗就黏住——肉體的。

members.senseAnchor: the fatty network of connective tissue that fills the cavities of bones; any of various squash plants grown for their elongated fruit with smooth dark green skin and whitish flesh
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 骨髓杯: marrow walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「骨髓杯」出場：marrow 一上場梗就黏住——精華骨髓。

related.synonyms: kernel, substance, core, center, centre, essence

members.senseAnchor: suggesting an unhealthy mental state; suggesting the horror of death and decay
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 黑趣味: morbid walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「黑趣味」出場：morbid 一上場梗就黏住——病態的。

members.senseAnchor: avoid responsibilities and duties, e.g., by pretending to be ill
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 假病假: malinger walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「假病假」出場：malinger 一上場梗就黏住——裝病。

members.senseAnchor: make wet and dirty, as from rain; limp and soiled as if dragged in the mud
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 落湯雞: bedraggled walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「落湯雞」出場：bedraggled 一上場梗就黏住——邋遢濕髒的。

related.synonyms: bedraggle, draggle, draggled, broken-down, derelict, dilapidated

members.senseAnchor: the dead and rotting body of an animal; unfit for human food
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 腐肉標: carrion walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「腐肉標」出場：carrion 一上場梗就黏住——腐肉。

members.senseAnchor: reduce in worth or character, usually verbally
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 貶低章: demean walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「貶低章」出場：demean 一上場梗就黏住——貶低。

members.senseAnchor: very thin especially from disease or hunger or cold
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 瘦削: gaunt walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「瘦削」出場：gaunt 一上場梗就黏住——憔悴的。

related.synonyms: bony, cadaverous, emaciated, haggard, pinched, skeletal

members.senseAnchor: a soldier of the American Revolution who was hanged as a spy by the British; his last words were supposed to have been `I only regret that I have but one life to give for my country' (1755-1776); United States astronomer who discovered that sunspots are associated with strong magnetic fields (1868-1938)
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 紅光臉: hale walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「紅光臉」出場：hale 一上場梗就黏住——健壯的。

related.synonyms: coerce, squeeze, pressure, force, haul, cart

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 蠟黃: sallow walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「蠟黃」出場：sallow 一上場梗就黏住——病黃色的。

members.senseAnchor: abnormally deficient in color as suggesting physical or emotional distress; (of light) lacking in intensity or brightness; dim or feeble
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 白紙臉: pallid walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「白紙臉」出場：pallid 一上場梗就黏住——蒼白的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 杠鈴: robust walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「杠鈴」出場：robust 一上場梗就黏住——強健的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 圖表: chart walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「圖表」出場：chart 一上場梗就黏住——圖表。
members.vocabNote: 留在幽默庫作構詞／劇本用；暫不列入 GRE 難詞主庫，避免稀釋考點密度。

pitfalls: morbid 可指病態興趣，不只生病
